verdict.rationale: Smithery provides building blocks for background automation rather than an automation runner. Triggers let a consumer subscribe to upstream events, which the server POSTs directly to the consumer, and automatic token refresh keeps connections valid without manual intervention. However, the user must build and host the agent or workflow that actually acts on those events. Missing for 10: a first-party way to define and schedule automations, Smithery-hosted background execution of agent workflows, monitoring of running automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
